title: A scoped reel brief in a different shape also loads slate
why: Triggering shouldn't depend on the words 'launch video': a reel with an aspect, a length and captions is just as scoped.
prompt: Cut a 15-second 9:16 reel for {brand}'s spring sale, with the captions burned in.
notes: Stopped on purpose (cut_off) at its time limit or its first render, whichever comes first: a scoped brief goes straight into a production that runs for hours, so the checks judge what the agent did before the stop, and an eval never renders on this Mac.
